Telangana’s Department of Culture would organise the birth centenary celebrations of Maha Kavi Gunturu Seshendra Sharma at Ravindra Bharathi Conference Hall in Hyderabad from 6 p.m. on Thursday (October 22, 2026).
The programme is being organised under the aegis of the Gunturu Seshendra Sharma Memorial Trust.
Nandini Sidha Reddy, former chairman of the Telangana Sahitya Akademi, will be the chief guest. Enugu Narasimha Reddy, Director of the Department of Culture, will preside, while Mandali Buddhaprasad, MLA will be the guest of honour.
